model.name: Image is a natural CLASS (UnitConvertible + MVC-renders-itself) — a dropped image instantiates the Image object
model.description: Image is a CLASS implementing UnitConvertible {isBinary/load/toUnit/fromUnit}; MimeType.from resolves a image drop (.png/.jpg/image-*) to the Image class (NO content-type string-switch outside MimeType). A dropped image RESOLVES to a Image scenario unit that is INSTANTIATED; the Image object owns model+view+controller and RENDERS ITSELF (detail + EXIF/preview) — not bytes-stored, not a handler branch. Specific Image behaviour that extends the R40.99 natural-class contract; re-homed from the T39 task (was orphaned hand-written ACs, PO 2026-09-06).
model.crossRefNote: Class-SPECIFIC extension of R40.99 (natural-class UnitConvertible MVC ruling). Gives the Image-specific ACs a single-source req home so T39 covers a specific req, not the broad umbrella.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Image implements UnitConvertible {isBinary/load/toUnit/fromUnit}; MimeType.from resolves a image drop (.png/.jpg/image-*) to the Image class; NO content-type string-switch outside MimeType.

gateRef.assertion: a image drop resolves to the Image class via MimeType.from; a content-type switch for images outside MimeType => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a content-type/format switch selecting behaviour for a image -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: A dropped image RESOLVES to a Image scenario unit that is INSTANTIATED; the Image object owns model+view+controller and RENDERS ITSELF (detail + EXIF/preview) — not bytes-stored, not a handler branch.

gateRef.assertion: a dropped image instantiates the Image and it renders its own detail+EXIF/preview; bytes-stored-without-Image-instantiated => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a image drop that stores bytes without instantiating the Image (or an external renderer) -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: DEFINITION OF DONE: the right CLASS (Image) is instantiated AND rendering itself; a mime/format switch handling images = RED (the defect).

gateRef.assertion: done = Image instantiated + rendering itself; a mime/format switch handling images => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed done-claimed with bytes-stored-only / a mime-switch for images -> RED
